welcome, capability preview, sample promotion and Get started list
preview_lines: Chart plans. Draw entry, stop and target on a chart in a note. It works out your size and can alert you at those levels.
Plan versus execution. Every closed trade is checked against your plan: entry, stop, size and target.
Entry context. The market at the moment you filled, saved with the trade: regime, days to earnings, RS rank.
Reviews that write themselves. One click drafts your daily, weekly or monthly review from your own trades.
My Playbook. Your setups side by side, each with how it has actually worked for you.
Active setups board. Every setup you are watching on one board, sorted by how close it is to your entry.
Reporting soon. Names you follow that report in the next week, with a prep note one click away.
Passed setups. The trades you chose not to take, scored later against what the stock did.
Writing help. Ask for a tighter or shorter version of what you wrote. Nothing changes until you accept it.
